THE MALACAÑANG MUSEUM
a.) The Malacañang Museum shall be placed under the supervision of the
National Museum for museological and related policy purposes, but
shall remain under the Office of the President for administrative and
budgetary purposes;
b.) The Malacañang Museum shall administer for, museum and other
purposes approved by the President of the Philippines, the following
structures and their associated grounds: Kalayaan Hall, the old

cafeteria building, the Boat House, the Goldenberg Mansion and Teus
Mansion, the Laperal Mansion (formerly Arlegui Guest House), the
Valdes Mansion, Bahay Uganayan and the Watson Building, the
second floor of which shall be made available to the National Museum
for purposes of perpetuating the memory and work of Dr. Henry Otley
Beyer, as well as any heritage or other structure or space designated by
the President;
c.) The Malacañang Museum shall continue to carry out its mandate as
stated in the Reorganization Plan of the Office of the President, as well
as any other duties and responsibilities designated by the President;
d.) The Malacarang Museum, in the pursuit of its mandate shall, subject
to available resources, establish branch museum at the mansion House
in Baguio City, Malacañang sa Subu in Cebu City and curate the
Presidential Yacht BRP Pag-Asa in coordination with the Philippine

THE PRESIDENTIAL SPECIAL COLLECTION
a) All properties, defined here as movable objects and items, of the
Office of the President, possessing significant artistic, historical and
cultural value, shall collectively be known as the Presidential Special
Collection, hereafter referred to as the "Collection";
b) The content and scope of the collection shall be studied and
recommended by the Malacañang Museum and National Museum and
submitted by the Board of Trustees of the National Museum for the
approval of the President;
c) After the approval by the President, the properties recommended for
inclusion in the Collection shall cease to be properties of the Office of
the President and, in line with pertinent regulations and procedures,
become properties of the National Museum, upon which the National
Museum shall have the primary responsibility of conserving,
managing and administering the Collection in conformity with this
Executive Order;
d) The Office of the President, through the Malacañang Museum, shall
have priority in accessing any item of the collection through
temporary, extended or permanent loan for appropriate display and use
in any structure officially used by the President, or for official
purposes, subject to the appropriate guidelines of the National
Museum, and likewise, any items of the Collection, not in use by the

stored of otherwise managed by the National Museum;
